overall_summary: Overall view counts across the channel are very low (mostly single digits to low double digits), except for a massive outlier on a non-core topic ('Maa Shayari' at 134 views). Among core self-respect and emotional topics, specific digital actions like deleting chats or clearing lists perform slightly better (e.g., 41 views), but statistical sample sizes are too small to declare definitive winners. Controlled exploration is required.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर उन्हीं का नाम था' (41 views) outperformed abstract emotional statements.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-moments related to phone habits and digital letting-go, but refine the pacing.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract emotional statements or overly specific niche digital unlinking
weak_patterns.evidence: Very niche actions like removing a profile from an OTT shared account ('जब उस एक पुरानी सीरीज़ के अकाउंट से...') got 0 views, and general ringtone changes got 3 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid extremely niche or obscure digital actions that lack universal relatability.
